matchups.update: Rilind's out here running a fucking clinic while Rob's watching his season crumble in real time—down 39.3 with Ashton Jeanty absolutely demolishing expectations and Rico Dowdle doing his best impression of a ghost on the field. The Texans D living up to their usual bullshit this week isn't helping Rob's cause either, but honestly, this one's already got the feel of a mercy killing: Rilind's got the momentum, the studs showing up, and Rob's desperately hoping for some late-week heroics that probably ain't coming.

Jetmir/Peter are up 12 and riding Caleb Williams like he just discovered the concept of accuracy, but let's talk about how Omarion Hampton decided this was the week to remember he's a fucking running back and not a practice squad ghost—that's a brutal underperformance when you need every point. Adam's got Jefferson doing his thing (finally showing up when it matters), but Drake Maye's looking like he forgot how to play quarterback, and if that 10-point deficit holds, that's gonna be a real "what the fuck happened" moment staring him down with two days left.

Ilir's sitting pretty with a 40-point cushion, and David Montgomery's been doing the heavy lifting with nearly 30 points—looks like that late-round flyer actually paid off for once. Meanwhile, Rinor's got Derrick Henry running like a man possessed (nearly 35 points, what a fucking game), but it's too little too late when your best receiver is George Pickens putting up couch numbers and Davante Adams decided to take the week off alongside him. This isn't completely over, but Ilir would need to completely implode for Rinor to sneak this one out.

Faton's getting absolutely demolished right now, down nearly 50 with D'Andre Swift carrying the entire fucking team on his back while Drake London decides to take the week off—and somehow that's still not enough to make this competitive. Meanwhile, Flamur's cruising with Isaiah Likely turning into a goddamn tight end unicorn, and even though Saquon's having a rare clunker, it doesn't matter because this lead is already insurmountable. Faton better hope the remaining players put up video game numbers, because right now this looks like watching someone try to summit Everest with a broken leg.

Arben's running away with this one while Veton's watching his studs get completely nullified by his duds—Ja'Marr Chase decided to take a fucking vacation with 2.2 points, and even Goedert's monster game on the other end isn't enough to keep pace. Meanwhile Chuba Hubbard's been doing heavy lifting for Arben, but don't get too comfortable yet: Terry McLaurin's been a total ghost so far, and there's still plenty of football left for Veton to chip away at that 17.8-point deficit if Chase remembers how to catch a ball.

Ben, you're getting absolutely obliterated out here—down 86.7 with Nori's Christian Watson going full apeshit mode while your Puka Nacua decided to take a fucking vacation. At least Ladd McConkey showed up to play, because literally nothing else on your side is preventing this from becoming a complete bloodbath. Nori's Watson single-handedly put up more points than your entire team, and even with Harrison Jr. laying an egg, you're still staring down a loss so bad it'll make your draft picks look competent by comparison.
